site.name: Somnia Magna
site.page_title: Somnia Magna | Bringing dreams to life
site.description: Somnia Magna is a photo-sharing map. Check in your location and share curated experiences from around the world, with events and partnerships coming soon.

about.heading: About
about.body:
Somnia Magna is Latin for "Big Dreams". It came out of a desire to share my curated experiences with the world, and eventually to bring future events to life.

Come follow me on my journey as I travel the world and share photos across the globe. It starts as a photo-sharing app where you can check in your location. In time it can also be used to plan events, find partnerships and bring them together, and share the stories of those events in the places they happen, all in one curated space.
